cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(annc-onnx2atir)

find_package(Protobuf REQUIRED)
find_package(MLIR REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(LLVM REQUIRED CONFIG)

# ONNX protobuf sources are pre-generated by frontends/onnx/protos/
# onnx_protos_minimal.sh (invoked from build.sh) exactly as the TensorFlow ones
# are, so CMake needs no protoc.
file(GLOB_RECURSE ONNX_PROTO_SRCS
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/frontends/onnx/protos/gen_code/*.pb.cc")

set(ANNC_ONNX2ATIR_SOURCES
    annc-onnx2atir.cpp
    onnx_frontend.cpp
    onnx_tensor_resolver.cpp
    onnx_tensor_decoder.cpp
    onnx_node_info_adapter.cpp
    onnx_mlir_builder.cpp
    onnx_transformers.cpp
    ${ONNX_PROTO_SRCS}
)

add_executable(annc-onnx2atir
    ${ANNC_ONNX2ATIR_SOURCES}
)

target_include_directories(annc-onnx2atir BEFORE PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/annc/include"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/frontends/onnx/protos/gen_code"
)
target_include_directories(annc-onnx2atir PRIVATE
    "${MLIR_INCLUDE_DIRS}"
    "${LLVM_INCLUDE_DIRS}"
)
target_include_directories(annc-onnx2atir SYSTEM PRIVATE
    "${Protobuf_INCLUDE_DIRS}"
)

find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
if(PkgConfig_FOUND)
    pkg_check_modules(ABSL_LOG QUIET absl_log)
    pkg_check_modules(ABSL_CHECK_OP QUIET absl_log_internal_check_op)
    pkg_check_modules(ABSL_BASE QUIET absl_base)
endif()

target_link_libraries(annc-onnx2atir PRIVATE
    ${Protobuf_LIBRARIES}
)

# The generated ONNX protobuf code pulls Abseil in through protobuf's logging
# macros, exactly as the TensorFlow protobuf code does.
if(ABSL_LOG_FOUND AND ABSL_CHECK_OP_FOUND)
    target_include_directories(annc-onnx2atir SYSTEM PRIVATE
        ${ABSL_LOG_INCLUDE_DIRS}
        ${ABSL_CHECK_OP_INCLUDE_DIRS}
        ${ABSL_BASE_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    )
    target_link_libraries(annc-onnx2atir PRIVATE
        ${ABSL_LOG_LIBRARIES}
        ${ABSL_CHECK_OP_LIBRARIES}
    )
endif()

target_link_libraries(annc-onnx2atir PRIVATE
    AtirBuilder AtirDialect AtirPasses
    AtirToLinalgConversion
    ContextConversion
    MLIRArithDialect
    MLIROptLib
    ${MLIR_LIBS}
    ${llvm_libs}
)
set_target_properties(annc-onnx2atir PROPERTIES
    INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/../lib"
    BUILD_RPATH "${Protobuf_LIB_DIRS}"
)
install(TARGETS annc-onnx2atir DESTINATION bin)

# The frontend's GTest suite lives in tests/unit/onnx2atir; this directory only
# builds the production tool.
